comparison.objective: Use a rigid pusher to extract a robot-assembly spacer through a covered path, recover it, and park the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated linear displacement/extraction in constrained geometry followed by part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Spacer recovered, pusher parked, and both released; the record explicitly lacks calibrated jam/force fidelity and gives no numeric scoring thresholds.
comparison.reason: It shares tool alignment and recovery, but tests pushing an intact spacer through a path; the candidate uniquely requires bimanual impact fracture at four notches while retaining coils and containing every new fragment.
